about: The Workbench icons of the Beret drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/ports/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art (art/beret.svg, drawn as an OS 3.5 GlowIcon: a round little hero in a green beret on a stone block, lifting a crate by telekinesis) is The AmiCradle Team's own, under the same terms as the other Amiga files; art/beret.png is it rendered at 128 x 128. Beret-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, Beret.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's Beret.info. ReadMe.info is also copied for Controls, LGPL-3.0.txt, OFL.txt, README-Beret.txt and Licences.txt; Data.info is the Data and User drawers' icon.
